title: Elderly Woman & Man with Boater Hat in Garden, 1920s Sepia Photo
description: A candid outdoor photograph from the 1920s featuring an elderly woman in a floral dress sitting in a wicker chair next to a gentleman wearing a classic straw boater hat, suit jacket, tie, and light trousers. The man is relaxing in a shaded canopy lawn chair while holding a pipe. The background shows lush garden foliage and a wooden house, capturing suburban domestic leisure during the Roaring Twenties.
